principle: Access class is metadata the future integration enforces. Carrying it in a record grants nothing: nothing in the application reads these fields today, and the corpus is not live. Reference knowledge is never globally exposed during closed-book Assessment merely because it exists.

classes.note: Charter section XXXII: Assessment restrictions must never be weakened to ingest content.

classes.entitlementNote: Entitlement is decided by the entitlement engine, not by this field.
